content.rationale: Undo and redo over the state is where the operation selections, the two effects, the count bounds and the two empty cases meet; this check drives the guards over the corpus states — named here, not claimed (S5-corpus, ylroyrvu) — and pins that undo steps back one operation per call and redo steps forward one operation per call — the markers standing — that an empty stack and an exhausted stack each refuse undo, that a redo at nothing-undone refuses as nothing is undone, that an append after an undo truncates the tail so there is nothing left to redo, that a position past the markers refuses both transitions, and that the corpus documents land exactly on one another through the transitions. The reverts undo records land against the operation it undoes, so the undo effect's recording is pinned here too. It reaches serde_json for the corpus, so it is a crate of its own; the JSON layer is I1-serde's. Its edges span two cells — the guards' natural-to-code fidelity cell and the corpus's code-to-code edge — so the criterion stays its test ref; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
